answers.how: Measured the pedestrian displacement on the left sidewalk (~99.7 px over 9.267 s in 854x480 resolution, or 10.76 px/s) to establish the scale from the 1.1 m/s prior (0.1022 m/px). Measured the perpendicular width of the straight-through lane (~38 px) and converted to meters.

Using the scale derived from the pedestrian walking speed (0.1022 m/px in 854x480 resolution), measured the radial width of the circulatory roundabout lane between the inner apron curb (R=120.5 px) and the lane divider line (R=161.5 px), giving ~41.5 px or 4.24 m.
Measured the diameter of the circular center island planter (~199-201 px in 854x480 resolution) and multiplied by the scale factor of 0.1022 m/px derived from the pedestrian prior.

Tracked the white car in the roundabout across frames around t=3.0s (Frames 87 to 93, dt=0.200s, and Frames 74 to 111, dt=1.233s), obtaining an angular/linear speed of ~57.5 px/s in 854x480 resolution, which converts to 5.9 m/s using the 0.1022 m/px scale.

Tracked the bicycle on the upper-left cycle path around t=3.0s (from Frame 74 at t=2.467s to Frame 111 at t=3.700s, and Frame 87 to Frame 93), measuring a speed of ~36.8 px/s in 854x480 resolution, corresponding to 3.76 m/s.

Located the two black cars inside the roundabout at Frame 30 (t=1.000s) at (276.5, 151.0) and (524.0, 88.0) in 854x480 resolution, measured the distance between them (~250 px), and converted to meters using the 0.1022 m/px scale.
